name: Effective Leaders
excerpt: Effective leaders inspire others through integrity, humility, and a strong work ethic.
notes: Effective leaders are those whom people would follow even without a formal title. They possess a positive outlook, humility, and a strong work ethic. Their behavior makes others feel important, and they focus on delivering results, holding people accountable, making difficult decisions, and overcoming obstacles. Effective leaders demonstrate integrity by doing the right thing when nobody's looking and do not command authority but guide others by example.
context_summary: - They have a strong work ethic.
- People would follow them without a title.
- They do the right thing when nobody's looking.
